# Phase Two — Architecture and File Map

> Chesed dreams of every scene, Gevurah gives the timeline law; Tiferes joins the many studios so one clear movie truth they draw.  
> The Awtsmoos is not divided by a canvas, mesh, or ray; Awtsmoos.com can give each vessel form while shared contracts guide the way.

## Competing Architectures Considered

### A — Animator Becomes the Universal Engine
Strong existing AI/camera/character stack, but too coupled to one app personality and too collision-prone in the current dirty tree.

### B — Nesher Studio Becomes the Universal Engine
Strong NLE/export stack, but would make procedural 3D and AI movie semantics secondary rather than foundational.

### C — New Standalone Movie Library Outside Procedural Core
Clean separation, but contradicts the goal of consolidating asset generation into Awtsmoos Procedural Core and creates another root library to maintain.

### D — Canonical Movie Domain Inside Procedural Core + Shared UI Library + App Adapters
Best fit. Procedural core owns domain truth and reusable asset intent; Awtsmoos UI owns declarative interface composition; each app owns rendering/editing personality through adapters. This is the selected architecture.

### E — One Monolithic New Studio Copying Every App
Fast demo, poor maintainability, duplicated export/render/UI logic, and directly opposed to code-reduction goals.

## Selected Layer Graph

`AI prompt / human edits`
→ `movie intent compiler`
→ `canonical MovieDocument`
→ `validation + capability planning`
→ `procedural asset intents`
→ `studio adapter / renderer personality`
→ `preview + export`

UI runs beside this graph:

`AwtsmoosUiRecipe`
→ `safe JSON compiler`
→ `DOM nodes + bindings + accessible controls`
→ `studio-specific recipe/profile`

## New Collision-Free Core Files

### `libs/awtsmoos-procedural-core/src/core/movie/`
- `MovieDocument.js` — normalize canonical movie metadata and scene list.
- `MovieScene.js` — scene timing and typed layer normalization.
- `MovieLayer.js` — common timed layer fields and supported layer kinds.
- `MovieKeyframe.js` — normalized keyframes/easing.
- `MovieTimelineEvaluator.js` — deterministic evaluation at arbitrary seconds.
- `MovieFeatureCatalog.js` — stable feature vocabulary AI can inspect.
- `MovieCapabilityPlanner.js` — match requested features to renderer capabilities/fallbacks.
- `MovieValidation.js` — structural/timing/coverage validation.
- `MovieAssetIntent.js` — portable requests for procedural assets.
- `MovieAssetCatalog.js` — discover 2D/3D/hybrid procedural capabilities already present in core.
- `MovieAiCompiler.js` — compile a compact high-level intent object into a canonical document.
- `index.js` — local movie exports only; do not touch dirty root `src/index.js` until safe integration is proven.

### `libs/awtsmoos-ui/`
- `package.json`
- `src/core/AwtsmoosUiCompiler.js` — recipe-to-DOM compiler.
- `src/core/AwtsmoosUiNode.js` — normalized recipe nodes.
- `src/core/AwtsmoosUiSafety.js` — safe tags/attrs/style/event rules.
- `src/core/AwtsmoosUiBindings.js` — value and action binding resolution.
- `src/tokens/AwtsmoosUiTokens.js` — mobile-first spacing/type/layout tokens.
- `src/presets/AwtsmoosStudioRecipe.js` — reusable studio shell recipe.
- `src/index.js`
- `test/AwtsmoosUiCompiler.test.mjs`

### `apps/awtsmoos-studio/`
- `index.html`
- `src/main.js`
- `src/app/AwtsmoosStudioApp.js`
- `src/app/AwtsmoosStudioState.js`
- `src/movie/AwtsmoosStudioMovie.js`
- `src/movie/AwtsmoosStudioPlayback.js`
- `src/render/CanvasMovieRenderer.js`
- `src/render/CanvasLayerRenderer.js`
- `src/render/CanvasParticleRenderer.js`
- `src/render/CanvasCharacterRenderer.js`
- `src/render/HybridRendererProfile.js`

## App Adapter Targets

Prefer new adapter files first:

- Animator: `apps/animator/src/shared/AwtsmoosMovieAdapter.js`
- Nesher: `apps/nesher-studio/modules/shared/AwtsmoosMovieAdapter.js`
- Mitzvah: `apps/mitzvah-studio/modules/shared/AwtsmoosMovieAdapter.js`
- Video Editor: `apps/video-editor/js/AwtsmoosMovieAdapter.js`
- Slides: `apps/slides/src/shared/AwtsmoosMovieAdapter.js`

Each adapter should translate its native concept into or out of `MovieDocument` while declaring a renderer personality/capability profile. Existing entrypoints will only be rewritten after fresh read + clean collision check.

## Asset Migration Strategy

Do not physically drag dirty Animator generators while agents are editing them. First create a core movie asset facade that directly exposes existing procedural-core primitives, human/creature systems, text, particle presets, plants, world objects, and materials. Then migrate clean duplicated app-side asset recipes into new procedural-core modules in later slices, replacing app generators with adapters. This immediately gives AI one asset vocabulary without destabilizing current work.

## Verification Graph

1. Syntax/import checks for every new JS module.
2. Unit tests for movie normalization, timeline evaluation, validation, capability fallback, AI compilation, and UI compilation.
3. 180-second fixture test proving exact duration and broad feature/camera coverage.
4. Browser smoke of Awtsmoos Studio desktop and mobile viewport.
5. Interaction smoke: play/pause/scrub/scene selection and prompt-generated project load.
6. Visual/runtime console check.
7. Export path test using fastest proven existing infrastructure or deterministic browser capture; validate output duration with media probe if produced.
8. Full line-count/tab/source-header audit.
9. Re-read all touched files and compare planned vs actual.

## Conflict Policy

Before every integration rewrite, refresh `git status` and read the exact file. If another session has modified a target since inspection, move integration into a new adapter/bootstrap file or defer only that collision-bound rewrite while continuing all independent work.
